**Packed-Texture:** A 2D or 3D texture containing only the voxels from bricks that are not fully transparent.
The bricks are stored contiguously or in a specific packing order.
**Index-Texture:** A texture (typically 3D or 2D depending on the brick grid) that stores the integer index of the brick in the Packed-Texture for every spatial location.

The resolution of the Index-Texture matches the resolution of the brick grid (e.g., if the volume is divided into $N \times N \times N$ bricks, the Index-Texture has dimensions $N \times N \times N$).

If the retrieved index is invalid (transparent brick), skip sampling or treat as background.
